post.author: Brian Bakerman
post.status: Public post body and visible comments read; embedded image unavailable. Not a verified Microsoft organization chart.
post.note: Counts are author estimates. Detailed agent titles are our functional decomposition, not extracted employee job titles. Telecoms is suggested by a visible comment; sustainability is our addition.

sources.title: DOE/FEMP: Best Practices Guide for Energy-Efficient Data Center Design (July 2024)
sources.context: Coordinate IT demand, environmental conditions, airflow, cooling, electrical distribution and heat recovery. Evaluate efficiency at consistent measurement boundaries; a single design is not optimal for every site.

sources.title: ASHRAE Handbook 2023, Chapter 20: Data Centers and Telecommunication Facilities
sources.access: Public chapter; equipment-specific limits still required
sources.context: Power, space, cooling and networking depend on each other. Use equipment environmental envelopes and measured inlet conditions; coordinate heat loads and serviceability across disciplines.

sources.title: Open Compute Project: Cold Plate project and contribution catalogue
sources.access: Public project overview; individual specification revisions must be checked
sources.context: Use cold-plate, manifold, fluid and CDU requirements as separate interfaces. Request selected equipment qualification, fluid compatibility, leak response and service procedures before accepting a liquid-cooling concept.

sources.title: Uptime Institute: Tier Classification System
sources.access: Public overview; topology standard and certification are separate
sources.context: Review maintainability and distribution paths as well as component redundancy. An N+1 capacity calculation alone cannot establish a Tier classification or certification.

sources.title: TIA-942: Telecommunications Infrastructure Standard for Data Centers
sources.access: Public overview only; full normative standard not reproduced
sources.context: Use a dedicated telecommunications design package and coordinate it with the physical facility. Obtain the applicable standard and project edition before making clause-level compliance claims.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3: Guide to Operational Technology Security (2023)
sources.access: Public final publication; Rev. 4 initial public draft exists, not substituted
sources.context: Treat building automation and physical environment monitoring as OT. Review asset inventories, network boundaries, access, monitoring and recovery with operational reliability constraints.

sources.title: WBDG: Roles and Responsibilities in the Commissioning Process
sources.context: Link owner requirements, basis of design, design reviews, commissioning plans, issues and operations manuals. Assign acceptance ownership and retain evidence of unresolved issues.

sources.title: ASCE/SEI 7-22: Minimum Design Loads and Associated Criteria
sources.access: Public publisher overview; US reference, not a global code
sources.context: Identify applicable structural loads and local code adoption. Request site-specific hazards and load combinations; this catalogue does not contain normative design values.

sources.title: buildingSMART: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC)
sources.context: Use explicit IFC exchange versions and validate model exchanges. Preserve object identity, units and discipline ownership when coordinating information across design tools.

sources.title: Microsoft: Sustainable by design, next-generation datacenters (9 December 2024)
sources.access: Public vendor announcement, not independent performance evidence
sources.context: Microsoft describes cooling without evaporative water consumption. Keep cooling water, total site water and supply-chain water separate; do not infer that every facility has zero water demand.

sources.title: Microsoft Careers: Datacenters
sources.access: Public role descriptions, not an organization chart
sources.context: Public examples include electrical and mechanical engineers, construction managers and commissioning managers, complementing the six groups described in the LinkedIn post.

roles.title: Data Center Design Director
roles.mandate: Translate capacity demand into a staged owner brief and explicit trade-offs across resilience, cost, schedule and energy.
review_checks: Define usable IT capacity separately from utility capacity
Record availability objectives and expansion phases
Assign unresolved decisions to accountable specialists

roles.title: Electrical Power Engineer
roles.mandate: Develop the grid-to-rack power concept and quantify capacity margins before detailed electrical studies.
review_checks: Separate peak planning multiplier from annual PUE
Review UPS bypass and maintenance paths
Request load-flow, fault-level, selectivity and arc-flash studies from qualified engineers

roles.title: Controls and Power Monitoring Engineer
roles.mandate: Define observable BMS/EPMS interfaces and failure-aware control review requirements.
review_checks: Map meters, alarms and timestamps to equipment IDs
Specify sensor failure and communications-loss responses
Review OT segmentation and change ownership

roles.title: Mechanical and Air Cooling Engineer
roles.mandate: Assess residual air-side heat removal and coordinate environmental limits with IT equipment.
review_checks: Check inlet rather than room-average conditions
Review containment and recirculation assumptions
Request design-weather and maintenance-mode thermal studies

roles.title: Liquid Cooling Engineer
roles.mandate: Scope direct-to-chip loops, CDU capacity and fluid interfaces for high-density racks.
review_checks: Verify TCS/FWS temperatures and pressure interfaces
Check fluid material compatibility and water quality
Request leak isolation, flushing and serviceability evidence

roles.title: Civil and Site Infrastructure Engineer
roles.mandate: Identify site constraints and due-diligence gaps affecting utility corridors, grading and access.
review_checks: Coordinate drainage, access and underground services
Identify local permitting and environmental constraints
Request survey and hazard evidence before site suitability conclusions

roles.title: Structural Engineer
roles.mandate: Frame structural verification for heavy racks, plant loads, anchors and equipment replacement routes.
review_checks: Check concentrated, dynamic and distributed loads separately
Include anchorage and site hazards under applicable codes
Request signed calculations; never infer slab adequacy from rack count

roles.title: Data Center Architect and BIM Coordinator
roles.mandate: Coordinate space, maintainability, life safety and model exchange requirements.
review_checks: Review equipment replacement routes and service clearances
Coordinate fire compartments and egress with local specialists
Set IFC versions, units and model ownership before exchanging geometry

roles.title: Telecommunications Infrastructure Engineer
roles.mandate: Define physical network pathways independently of electrical and controls design.
review_checks: Check carrier entrances for shared physical failure points
Coordinate meet-me rooms, pathways and rack interfaces
Request optical budgets and cabling acceptance tests

roles.title: Energy and Water Performance Engineer
roles.mandate: Compare energy and water scenarios with explicit boundaries and site-specific evidence.
review_checks: Keep annual PUE separate from peak sizing
Declare WUE denominator and cooling-versus-site water boundary
Request hourly tariffs, emissions, climate and source provenance before optimization

roles.title: Commissioning and Handover Engineer
roles.mandate: Plan verifiable acceptance from owner requirements through integrated systems testing.
review_checks: Trace test acceptance criteria to owner requirements
Plan loss-of-utility, failed-component and recovery scenarios with authorized teams
Track defects, retests, training and handover evidence

roles.title: Data Center Design Manager
roles.mandate: Coordinate design packages, dependencies, review gates and unresolved interfaces.
review_checks: Reconcile specialist scope and assumptions
Assign owners and dates to unresolved interfaces
Preserve missing evidence and design changes in gate reports

roles.title: Technical Governance Lead
roles.mandate: Independently review evidence completeness, exceptions and resilience claims before escalation.
review_checks: Identify adopted standards and editions by jurisdiction
Distinguish calculations from verified compliance
Reject certification claims based only on redundancy arithmetic

roles.title: End-to-End Delivery Manager
roles.mandate: Turn coordinated design into a staged procurement, construction and handover proposal.
review_checks: Track long-lead equipment and energization dependencies
Carry design gaps into procurement and construction risks
Keep ready-for-service acceptance separate from completed agent execution
